zh: 请解释原文的 Nef abundance 方法在光滑 K3 曲面上怎样运作。先看原文的一般证明在这个情形中的具体形式。
en: How does the original Nef abundance method work on a smooth K3 surface? First explain the specialization of the paper’s general proof.

zh: 这里的 \(B\) 是有效有理边界，还是任意 nef 除子？
en: Does \(B\) mean an effective rational boundary, or an arbitrary nef divisor?

zh: 我指任意 nef 除子 \(B\)，不是有效边界；要看的是 Nef abundance 那篇文章。
en: I mean an arbitrary nef divisor \(B\), not an effective boundary. The intended paper is the one on Nef abundance.

zh: 对应文章是 Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors。原文将有效边界记为 \(B\)，将任意 nef 除子记为 \(M\)。沿用你的记号，下文的 \(B\) 表示 nef 除子，对应原文的 \(M\)；原文边界取零。
en: The corresponding paper is Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors. It denotes the effective boundary by \(B\) and the arbitrary nef divisor by \(M\). In your notation, \(B\) below denotes the nef divisor corresponding to the paper’s \(M\); the boundary in the paper is set to zero.

zh: 在光滑射影 K3 曲面上，
\[K_X\sim0,\qquad B\ \text{nef 且为 }\mathbb Q\text{-除子}.\]
文章的主定理声称
\[B\equiv A,\qquad A\ \text{semiample}.\]
K3 曲面上数值平凡线丛是平凡线丛，因此这一结论进一步给出
\[B\sim_{\mathbb Q}A\quad\Longrightarrow\quad |mB|\ \text{对某个 }m>0\text{ 无基点}.\]
这里只将文章的结论代入 K3，未验证其证明。待核查的是如何产生 \(A\)，尤其 \(B^2=0\) 时截面从哪里来。
en: On a smooth projective K3 surface,
\[K_X\sim0,\qquad B\ \text{is a nef }\mathbb Q\text{-divisor}.\]
The main theorem of the paper claims
\[B\equiv A,\qquad A\ \text{is semiample}.\]
A numerically trivial line bundle on a K3 surface is trivial, so this conclusion further gives
\[B\sim_{\mathbb Q}A\quad\Longrightarrow\quad |mB|\ \text{is basepoint-free for some }m>0.\]

This only specializes the paper’s conclusion to K3; its proof has not been checked. What remains to be examined is how the paper produces \(A\), especially where the sections come from when \(B^2=0\).

zh: 请将原文证明一般结论的方法代入光滑射影 K3 曲面，不要换成独立的 Riemann–Roch 证明或专门的 K3 定理。目标是数值有效：对 nef Cartier 除子 \(D\)，找到有效 \(\mathbb Q\)-除子 \(E\) 使 \(D\equiv E\)。
en: Specialize the paper’s proof of the general result to a smooth projective K3 surface; do not replace it with a standalone Riemann–Roch proof or a special K3 theorem. The target is numerical effectivity: for a nef Cartier divisor \(D\), find an effective \(\mathbb Q\)-divisor \(E\) with \(D\equiv E\).

zh: 原文的有效边界取零，nef 部分对应这里的 \(D\)。我们考察的是光滑射影曲面 \(X\)、\(K_X\sim0\) 时的一般证明，目标仍是 \(D\equiv E\)。
en: The effective boundary in the paper is zero, and its nef summand corresponds to our \(D\). We are examining the general proof for a smooth projective surface \(X\) with \(K_X\sim0\); the target remains \(D\equiv E\).

zh: 回顾一下 nef reduction 和 nef dimension 的定义。
en: Recall the definitions of nef reduction and nef dimension.

zh: 对 nef 除子 \(D\)，nef reduction 是支配的、几乎全纯的有理映射
\[f_D:X\dashrightarrow Y\]
其纤维连通；在一般的、具有预期维数的紧纤维上，\(D\) 数值平凡。经过非常一般点、且不被收缩的整曲线 \(C\) 满足 \(D\cdot C>0\)。
\[n(X,D)=\dim Y.\]
曲面上 \(n(X,D)=2\) 并不按定义推出 \(D^2>0\)。
en: For a nef divisor \(D\), the nef reduction is a dominant, almost holomorphic rational map
\[f_D:X\dashrightarrow Y\]

with connected fibres. The divisor \(D\) is numerically trivial on a general compact fibre of the expected dimension. Every integral curve \(C\) through a very general point that is not contracted satisfies \(D\cdot C>0\).
\[n(X,D)=\dim Y.\]
On a surface, \(n(X,D)=2\) does not imply \(D^2>0\) by definition.

zh: 为什么 nef dimension 不能是零？
en: Why can the nef dimension not be zero?

zh: 可以是零。\(n(X,D)=0\) 当且仅当 \(D\equiv0\)，此时直接取 \(E=0\)。在处理完这个情形并假设 \(D\not\equiv0\) 后，才只剩 \(n(X,D)=1\) 或 \(2\)。
也不能用“曲线只有可数条”来推出 \(n(X,D)=2\)：K3 上的曲线不必形成可数集，椭圆纤维化就有一族纤维。
en: It can be zero. We have \(n(X,D)=0\) if and only if \(D\equiv0\), in which case take \(E=0\). Only after treating this case and assuming \(D\not\equiv0\) do the possibilities reduce to \(n(X,D)=1\) or \(2\).
Nor can one infer \(n(X,D)=2\) by claiming that there are only countably many curves: curves on a K3 surface need not form a countable set; an elliptic fibration has a family of fibres.
When \(D^2=0\), how is \(n(X,D)=2\) excluded?

zh: 若 \(n(X,D)=1\)，在双有理模型 \(p:\widetilde X\to X\) 上，nef reduction 的下降给出到底曲线的映射 \(f:\widetilde X\to C\)，以及 \(C\) 上的除子 \(A\)，满足
\[p^*D\equiv f^*A,\qquad \deg A\ge0.\]
曲线上 \(A\equiv a[c]\)、\(a\ge0\)。将这一有效数值代表拉回再推前，得到 \(D\) 的有效数值代表。这一步使用下降引理，不只是 nef reduction 的定义。
若 \(n(X,D)=2\)，原文声称：\(K_X\sim0\) 时满 nef dimension 的一般定理推出 \(D\) big，与 \(D^2=0\) 矛盾。它通过 Frobenius 比较喷射估计；两个核心几何估计尚未完整核查，所以这仍是论文声称的排除路径，不是已完成的验证。不能把它改写成不需要 \(K_X\sim0\) 的独立小体积喷射论证。
en: If \(n(X,D)=1\), descent for the nef reduction on a birational model \(p:\widetilde X\to X\) gives a map \(f:\widetilde X\to C\) to a curve and a divisor \(A\) on \(C\) such that
\[p^*D\equiv f^*A,\qquad \deg A\ge0.\]

On the curve, \(A\equiv a[c]\) with \(a\ge0\). Pulling back this effective numerical representative and then pushing it forward gives an effective numerical representative of \(D\). This uses a descent lemma, not merely the definition of nef reduction.

If \(n(X,D)=2\), the paper claims that its general full-nef-dimension theorem for \(K_X\sim0\) makes \(D\) big, contradicting \(D^2=0\). The proof compares jet estimates via Frobenius. The two core geometric estimates have not been fully audited, so this is the paper’s claimed exclusion route, not a completed verification. It is not a standalone small-volume jet argument that dispenses with \(K_X\sim0\).

zh: 这里的两个 jet 命题具体在说什么？
en: What exactly do the two jet statements say here?

zh: 在反例情形，\(X\) 是光滑射影曲面，\(K_X\sim0\)，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子，\(n(X,D)=2\)，\(D^2=0\)。取 ample Cartier 除子 \(A\)，以及正有理数 \(\varepsilon\)，满足
\[(14\varepsilon)^2<\tfrac14,\qquad80\varepsilon<\tfrac34.\]
直接选择正整数 \(r_n\to\infty\)，使
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
例如，略去有限个初始项后，将 \(\varepsilon/\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}\) 四舍五入到最近的正整数。
原文的第一个声明：对所有充分大的 \(n\)、非常一般的光滑点 \(x\in X\)，对每个 \(k>0\) 使 \(kP_n\) 为 Cartier，以及每个非零截面 \(s\in H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(kP_n))\)，有
\[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}.\]
这里的消失阶，是在局部平凡化下 \(s_x\in\mathfrak m_x^a\) 所允许的最大 \(a\)。这一核心估计尚未完整核查。
en: In the counterexample case, \(X\) is a smooth projective surface, \(K_X\sim0\), \(D\) is nef Cartier, \(n(X,D)=2\), and \(D^2=0\). Choose an ample Cartier divisor \(A\) and a positive rational \(\varepsilon\) satisfying
\[(14\varepsilon)^2<\tfrac14,\qquad80\varepsilon<\tfrac34.\]
Directly choose positive integers \(r_n\to\infty\) such that
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
For example, after discarding finitely many initial terms, round \(\varepsilon/\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}\) to the nearest positive integer.

The first claim in the paper is that, for all sufficiently large \(n\), a very general smooth point \(x\in X\), every \(k>0\) with \(kP_n\) Cartier, and every nonzero section \(s\in H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(kP_n))\),
\[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}.\]
In a local trivialization, the order is the largest \(a\) such that \(s_x\in\mathfrak m_x^a\). This core estimate has not been fully audited.

zh: 第二个声明在辅助空间上。记 \(p_1,p_2:X\times X\to X\)，取
\[\pi:Z=\mathbb P\!\left(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D)\right)\longrightarrow X\times X.\]
使用 \(\pi_*\mathcal O_Z(a)=\operatorname{Sym}^a(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D))\)、\(a\ge0\) 的约定。此时 \(\dim Z=5\)。令
\[\xi=c_1\mathcal O_Z(1),\quad P_{n,i}=\pi^*p_i^*P_n,\quad R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi.\]
原文声称：选定一个固定正整数 \(q\) 后，对所有充分大的 \(n\)，存在不在两个自然截面上的光滑点 \(z\)，使
\[\epsilon(R_n;z)=\inf_{C\ni z}\frac{R_n\cdot C}{\operatorname{mult}_z C}>6.\]
于是，对充分大且可除的 \(k_0\)，有满射
\[H^0(Z,\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n))\longrightarrow\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n)_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\left(\mathcal O_{Z,z}/\mathfrak m_z^{6k_0+1}\right).\]
也就是说，五个局部坐标中任意总次数不超过 \(6k_0\) 的 Taylor 多项式，都可由一个全局截面实现。这比“存在一个高阶消失截面”更强。
这一满射推论通过在 \(z\) 处吹起 \(b\)、取有理数 \(6<a<\epsilon(R_n;z)\)，利用 \(b^*R_n-aG\) 的 ample 性和 Serre 消失得到；\(G\) 是例外除子。第二个核心几何估计仍未完整核查。两种估计在不同空间上，必须经过原文的 Frobenius 比较，不能仅把它们并列就得出矛盾。
en: The second claim is on an auxiliary space. Write \(p_1,p_2:X\times X\to X\), and let
\[\pi:Z=\mathbb P\!\left(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D)\right)\longrightarrow X\times X.\]
Use the convention \(\pi_*\mathcal O_Z(a)=\operatorname{Sym}^a(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D))\) for \(a\ge0\). Then \(\dim Z=5\). Set
\[\xi=c_1\mathcal O_Z(1),\quad P_{n,i}=\pi^*p_i^*P_n,\quad R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi.\]
The paper claims that, after choosing a fixed positive integer \(q\), for all sufficiently large \(n\) there is a smooth point \(z\) outside the two natural sections such that
\[\epsilon(R_n;z)=\inf_{C\ni z}\frac{R_n\cdot C}{\operatorname{mult}_z C}>6.\]
Consequently, for sufficiently large divisible \(k_0\), the following map is surjective:
\[H^0(Z,\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n))\longrightarrow\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n)_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\left(\mathcal O_{Z,z}/\mathfrak m_z^{6k_0+1}\right).\]

Thus every prescribed Taylor polynomial of total degree at most \(6k_0\) in five local coordinates can be realized by a global section. This is stronger than the existence of one section with high vanishing order.

This surjectivity follows by blowing up \(z\), with blowup map \(b\) and exceptional divisor \(G\), choosing a rational \(6<a<\epsilon(R_n;z)\), and using the ampleness of \(b^*R_n-aG\) and Serre vanishing. The second core geometric estimate has not been fully audited. The two estimates live on different spaces: the paper’s Frobenius comparison is needed, and simply juxtaposing them gives no contradiction.

zh: 后面的研读回复请用英文写。
en: Please write the subsequent study explanations in English.

zh: 后续笔记与正式引理用英文整理；这里保留对应的双语研读记录。
en: The subsequent note and formal lemmas are written in English; corresponding bilingual study records are retained here.

zh: 请先整理成临时英文学习笔记，写出所讨论引理的具体陈述与证明。
en: Please prepare a temporary English study note with explicit statements and proofs of the lemmas discussed.

zh: 笔记按已讨论内容整理，区分已经展开的曲面步骤与仍待核查的原文断言。
en: The note separates the surface arguments already expanded from assertions in the original paper that remain unchecked.

zh: 直接专门化到曲面，不要留下抽象的低维断言作为额外假设。
en: Specialize directly to surfaces; do not leave an abstract lower-dimensional assertion as an extra assumption.

zh: 一维的正性输入由次数给出：
\[\deg T\ge0,\quad\deg N\ge0,\quad\deg(T+aN)>0\ \text{对某个 }a>0.\]
则对每个 \(c>0\)，\(\deg(T+cN)>0\)，所以 \(T+cN\) big。曲面讨论不再保留一个额外的抽象一维假设。
这里的不 big 来自已设定的 \(D^2=0\)；单独的 \(n(X,D)=2\) 并不意味着不 big。
en: The dimension-one positivity input follows from degrees:
\[\deg T\ge0,\quad\deg N\ge0,\quad\deg(T+aN)>0\ \text{for some }a>0.\]
Then \(\deg(T+cN)>0\) for every \(c>0\), so \(T+cN\) is big. No additional abstract dimension-one assumption remains in the surface discussion.
Here non-bigness comes from the stipulated \(D^2=0\); \(n(X,D)=2\) alone does not mean that \(D\) is not big.

zh: 引理只用编号，不加 scalar bound 等自拟副标题。每个引理写清全部条件，并直接说明曲面情形。
en: Use plain numbered lemmas without invented subtitles such as “scalar bound.” State every hypothesis explicitly and specialize to surfaces.

zh: 采用普通引理编号，逐条列出对象和假设；不以额外副标题代替准确陈述。
en: Use plain lemma numbering and explicit objects and hypotheses, rather than explanatory subtitles.

zh: 能否直接用 \(A/n\) 定义 \(P_n\)，不另外引入小参数？
en: Can we define \(P_n\) directly using \(A/n\), without introducing an extra small parameter?

zh: 可以。直接定义
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty,\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
无需额外参数。相应的 \(R_n\) 和喷射估计仍要求 \(n\) 充分大；\(n\) 是序列下标，不是 nef dimension。核心喷射估计和 Frobenius 比较的证明仍未完整核查。
en: Yes. Define directly
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty,\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]

No extra parameter is needed. The corresponding \(R_n\) and the jet estimates still require sufficiently large \(n\); \(n\) is the sequence index, not the nef dimension. The proofs of the core jet estimates and the Frobenius comparison remain unaudited.

zh: 我说的是 \(1/n\to0\)，不是固定的 \(1/2\)。直接用 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\)，不要再引入 \(t\) 或 \(t_n\)。
en: I mean \(1/n\to0\), not the fixed value \(1/2\). Use \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) directly, without \(t\) or \(t_n\).

zh: 按最终意图采用 \(A/n\)。\(r_n\) 的取整与自交数收敛作为独立初步引理说明。
en: Use \(A/n\) as intended. Explain integer rounding for \(r_n\) and convergence of the self-intersection in a separate preliminary lemma.

zh: \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\) 是什么意思？这里选取的乘数和 \(R_n\) 有什么区别？
en: What does \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\) mean? How does the chosen multiplier differ from \(R_n\)?

zh: 箭头表示数值自交数的收敛：\(\lim_{n\to\infty}P_n^2=\varepsilon^2\)，不是每个 \(n\) 都满足等式。小写 \(r_n\) 是定义 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) 的正整数乘数；大写 \(R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi\) 是辅助空间 \(Z\) 上的除子，二者不同。
en: The arrow means convergence of numerical self-intersection: \(\lim_{n\to\infty}P_n^2=\varepsilon^2\), not equality for each \(n\). The lowercase \(r_n\) is the positive integer multiplier in \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\); the uppercase \(R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi\) is a divisor on the auxiliary space \(Z\). They are different.

zh: 总能选择这样的 \(r_n\)，使 \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\) 吗？请先把它写成一个初步引理。
en: Can we always choose such \(r_n\) so that \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\)? State this first as a preliminary lemma.

verification: 直接展开自交数：D²=0，nef 性给出 D·A≥0，ample 性给出 A²>0；最近整数的误差至多 1/2，因 u_n→0 而消失。此核查只针对初步引理，不包括原文的 jet/Frobenius 估计。
zh: 引理。设 \(X\) 是光滑射影曲面，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子且 \(D^2=0\)，\(A\) 是 ample Cartier 除子。对每个 \(\varepsilon>0\)，存在正整数 \(r_n\to\infty\)，使
\[P_n:=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
证明。令
\[u_n:=\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}=\sqrt{\frac{2D\cdot A}{n}+\frac{A^2}{n^2}}>0.\]
由 \(D\cdot A\ge0\)、\(A^2>0\) 得到 \(u_n\to0\)。对充分大的 \(n\)，取距离 \(\varepsilon/u_n\) 最近的正整数 \(r_n\)，则
\[|r_nu_n-\varepsilon|\le\frac{u_n}{2}\longrightarrow0,\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty.\]
所以
\[P_n^2=(r_nu_n)^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
有限个初始项可以取 \(r_n=1\)。这个初步引理已由上述交数与取整计算核查；不需要 \(K_X\sim0\)，也不需要 \(n(X,D)=2\)。原文的核心喷射估计与 Frobenius 比较仍未完整核查。
en: Lemma. Let \(X\) be a smooth projective surface, \(D\) a nef Cartier divisor with \(D^2=0\), and \(A\) an ample Cartier divisor. For every \(\varepsilon>0\), there exist positive integers \(r_n\to\infty\) such that
\[P_n:=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
Proof. Set
\[u_n:=\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}=\sqrt{\frac{2D\cdot A}{n}+\frac{A^2}{n^2}}>0.\]
Since \(D\cdot A\ge0\) and \(A^2>0\), we have \(u_n\to0\). For sufficiently large \(n\), choose \(r_n\) to be the nearest positive integer to \(\varepsilon/u_n\). Then
\[|r_nu_n-\varepsilon|\le\frac{u_n}{2}\longrightarrow0,\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty.\]
Hence
\[P_n^2=(r_nu_n)^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]

For the finitely many initial terms, take \(r_n=1\). This preliminary lemma has been checked by the intersection calculation and rounding estimate above. Neither \(K_X\sim0\) nor \(n(X,D)=2\) is required. The paper’s core jet estimates and Frobenius comparison remain unaudited.

zh: 非常一般点 \(x\) 要随 \(n\) 重新选择吗？
en: Must the very general point \(x\) be chosen again for each \(n\)?

zh: 不需要。对可数多个指标及整数喷射阶的真闭例外集合取并，选取并集之外的同一个 \(x\)，即可同时处理所有指标。这里是非常一般点条件，不是仅删去一个真闭集。
en: No. Take the union of the proper closed exceptional sets for the countably many indices and integral jet orders, then choose the same \(x\) outside that union. This is a very-general-point condition, not merely removal of one proper closed set.

zh: 充分大的阈值 \(N\) 也不依赖点 \(x\)，对吗？
en: Is the threshold \(N\) independent of the point \(x\)?

zh: 陈述要求统一的量词次序：\[\exists N,\{Z_i\}_{i\ge1}\quad\forall x\notin\bigcup_iZ_i\quad\forall n\ge N\quad\forall k\ (kP_n\text{ Cartier})\quad\forall E\in|kP_n|.\]其中 \(N\) 只依赖固定数据与序列；对应的结论为 \(\operatorname{mult}_xE\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}\)。
en: The statement uses uniform quantifiers: \[\exists N,\{Z_i\}_{i\ge1}\quad\forall x\notin\bigcup_iZ_i\quad\forall n\ge N\quad\forall k\ (kP_n\text{ Cartier})\quad\forall E\in|kP_n|.\]The integer \(N\) depends only on the fixed data and sequence; the conclusion is \(\operatorname{mult}_xE\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}\).

zh: 主喷射引理要明确 \(X\) 是光滑 K3 曲面，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子且 \(n(X,D)=2\)。
en: State explicitly in the main jet lemma that \(X\) is a smooth K3 surface and \(D\) is nef Cartier with \(n(X,D)=2\).

zh: 保留这些条件，也保留独立假设 \(D^2=0\)；\(n(X,D)=2\) 并不推出 \(D^2=0\)。
en: Retain these hypotheses and the separate assumption \(D^2=0\); nef dimension two does not imply \(D^2=0\).

zh: 使 \(kP_n\) 为 Cartier 的 \(k\) 可以依赖 \(n\) 吗？阈值 \(N\) 和非常一般点 \(x\) 的选择是否统一？
en: Can the integer \(k\) making \(kP_n\) Cartier depend on \(n\)? Are the threshold \(N\) and the very general point \(x\) chosen uniformly?

zh: 可以。\(k=n\) 总能清除 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) 的分母。阈值 \(N\) 只依赖固定数据 \(X,D,A,\varepsilon,(r_n)\)，不依赖 \(x,k,E\)。
对可数多个 \(n,k\) 和整数喷射阶，将例外的真闭子集取可数并，可得到一个共同的非常一般点集合：其中每个 \(x\) 同时适用于所有 \(n\ge N\)、所有使 \(kP_n\) 为 Cartier 的正整数 \(k\)，以及所有 \(E\in|kP_n|\)。
en: Yes. The choice \(k=n\) always clears the denominators of \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\). The threshold \(N\) depends only on the fixed data \(X,D,A,\varepsilon,(r_n)\), not on \(x,k,E\).

Taking the countable union of exceptional proper closed subsets for the countably many \(n,k\) and integral jet orders gives a common very general locus. Every \(x\) in that locus works simultaneously for all \(n\ge N\), every positive integer \(k\) with \(kP_n\) Cartier, and every \(E\in|kP_n|\).

zh: \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) 是极大理想上的阶吗？是不是取 valuation 的负值？
en: Is \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) the order with respect to the maximal ideal? Is it the negative of a valuation?

zh: 在局部标架中写 \(s=f e\)，则 \[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)=\max\{a\ge0:f\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]对正则截面是非负数，不加负号；更换标架只把 \(f\) 乘以单位，不改变阶。曲面上这是点的消失阶，不能直接混同于某个素除子上的离散赋值。
en: In a local frame write \(s=f e\). Then \[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)=\max\{a\ge0:f\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]It is nonnegative for a regular section, with no minus sign. Changing the frame multiplies \(f\) by a unit. On a surface this pointwise vanishing order should not be identified directly with a divisorial discrete valuation.

zh: \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) 怎样定义？线丛截面怎样典范地看成函数？改用线性系中有效除子的重数是否更清楚？
en: How is \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) defined? Can a line-bundle section be viewed canonically as a function? Would the multiplicity of an effective divisor in a linear system be clearer?

zh: 采用除子表述：\(E\in|H|\) 表示有效 Cartier 除子 \(E\sim H\)。若 \(g\) 是 \(E\) 在 \(x\) 处的局部方程，则
\[\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\max\{a\ge0:g\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]
将 \(g\) 乘以单位不改变这个数。若 \(E=(s)_0\) 是非零截面 \(s\) 的零除子，则 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\)。

固定 Cartier 除子 \(H\) 后，可将 \(\mathcal O_X(H)\) 嵌入函数域，使用满足 \(\operatorname{div}(f)+H\ge0\) 的有理函数 \(f\)。若 \(h\) 是 \(H\) 的局部方程，则零除子的局部方程是 \(fh\)，不是单独的 \(f\)。所以截面阶一般不能直接写成有理函数 \(f\) 的阶。最终用 \(E\in|kP_n|\) 与 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)\) 即可，不必另加避开支集的条件。
en: Use divisors: \(E\in|H|\) means an effective Cartier divisor with \(E\sim H\). If \(g\) is a local equation of \(E\) at \(x\), then
\[\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\max\{a\ge0:g\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]
Multiplying \(g\) by a unit does not change this number. If \(E=(s)_0\) is the zero divisor of a nonzero section \(s\), then \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\).

After fixing a Cartier divisor \(H\), one may embed \(\mathcal O_X(H)\) into the function field and use rational functions \(f\) satisfying \(\operatorname{div}(f)+H\ge0\). If \(h\) is a local equation of \(H\), the zero divisor has local equation \(fh\), not \(f\) alone. Thus the section order is not generally the order of the rational function \(f\). The final formulation with \(E\in|kP_n|\) and \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)\) needs no support-avoidance condition.

zh: 这与 Nakayama 的 \(\sigma\)-分解中的重数相似吗？
en: Is this similar to the multiplicity in Nakayama’s \(\sigma\)-decomposition?

zh: 都涉及重数，但 \(\sigma\) 沿素除子 \(\Gamma\) 取有效代表的下确界。对 big 的 \(\mathbb R\)-除子 \(L\)，
\[\sigma_\Gamma(L)=\inf\{\operatorname{mult}_\Gamma\Delta:\Delta\ge0,\ \Delta\sim_{\mathbb R}L\}.\]
对伪有效 \(L\)，先加 ample 扰动再取极限。我们的引理则是对点 \(x\) 处每个 \(E\in|kP_n|\) 给出重数上界，不能混同。参见 Lazić–Xie (2025), Definition 2.12。
en: Both involve multiplicity, but \(\sigma\) takes an infimum over effective representatives along a prime divisor \(\Gamma\). For a big \(\mathbb R\)-divisor \(L\),
\[\sigma_\Gamma(L)=\inf\{\operatorname{mult}_\Gamma\Delta:\Delta\ge0,\ \Delta\sim_{\mathbb R}L\}.\]

For pseudoeffective \(L\), add an ample perturbation and take the limit. Our lemma instead bounds the multiplicity at a point \(x\) of every \(E\in|kP_n|\) from above. These notions must not be conflated. See Lazić–Xie (2025), Definition 2.12.

en: State the multiplicity bound completely in the surface case.

en: Lemma 2.1 in the current note (before section-based numbering in this exchange). Let \(X\) be a smooth projective K3 surface in characteristic zero, and \(D\) a nef Cartier divisor with
Fix an ample Cartier divisor \(A\) and a positive rational \(\varepsilon\). The later comparison in the paper uses
\[(14\varepsilon)^2<\tfrac14,\qquad80\varepsilon<\tfrac34.\]
Choose positive integers \(r_n\to\infty\) and set
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]

Then there exist a positive integer \(N\) and proper closed subsets \(Z_i\subsetneq X\), \(i\ge1\), such that every \(x\in X\setminus\bigcup_iZ_i\) satisfies, simultaneously for every \(n\ge N\), every positive integer \(k\) with \(kP_n\) Cartier, and every effective divisor \(E\in|kP_n|\),

How important are \(14\), \(1/4\), \(3/4\), and \(80\)? Can \(1/4\) be replaced by \(1/8\)?

zh: 重数上界的曲面证明只需要固定的有限 \(\varepsilon>0\)，因而 \(\sqrt{P_n^2}\) 有界，而 \(r_n\to\infty\)。上述小常数条件服务于后续 Frobenius 行列式比较。
若矩阵大小为 \(M\)，秩小于 \(M/4\) 给出消失阶下界 \(3M/4\)，要与上界
\[M\bigl(80\varepsilon+O(1/p)\bigr)\]
竞争；\(80=40+40\)。把 \(1/4\) 换成 \(1/8\) 是更强的充分约束。这里没有声称常数最优，也没有完整核查后续比较。
en: The surface proof of the multiplicity bound only needs a fixed finite \(\varepsilon>0\): then \(\sqrt{P_n^2}\) stays bounded while \(r_n\to\infty\). The small-constant conditions serve the later Frobenius determinant comparison.
For a matrix of size \(M\), rank less than \(M/4\) gives a vanishing-order lower bound \(3M/4\), competing with the upper bound
\[M\bigl(80\varepsilon+O(1/p)\bigr).\]
Here \(80=40+40\). Replacing \(1/4\) by \(1/8\) is a stronger sufficient constraint. No optimality of these constants or full verification of the later comparison is claimed.

zh: 请把原文方法的证明补全，不要只给引理陈述。
en: Please expand the proof following the original method, rather than giving only its statement.

zh: 曲面论证分为孤立基点估计、移动曲线估计及主重数上界；完整证明写入笔记。后面的辅助几何断言和 Frobenius 比较仍须另外核查。
